source: CEPII BACI V202601, based on UN Comtrade

810820.title: Titanium, unwrought; powders
810820.boundary: Includes sponge and ingot; does NOT distinguish aerospace-qualified from commercial grade.

750210.title: Nickel, unwrought, not alloyed
750210.boundary: Superalloy base metal, but most nickel trade is non-aerospace; context only.

841112.title: Turbojets of a thrust exceeding 25 kN
841112.boundary: Large jet engines as traded; excludes engines fitted to delivered aircraft and captive OEM transfers.

841122.title: Turbo-propellers of a power exceeding 1,100 kW
841122.boundary: Turboprop engines as traded; same captive-transfer caveat.

841191.title: Parts of turbojets or turbo-propellers
841191.boundary: Engine parts as traded; a re-export/repair hub can surface as a 'maker'.
